name: CargoFlow
tagline: Distributed intercity logistics and cargo-capacity booking
description: A production-style logistics platform built as eight Node.js microservices behind an API gateway, combining synchronous REST APIs with event-driven Kafka workflows.
keyFeatures: Distributed booking saga: Coordinates inventory locks, Razorpay payment, confirmation and rollback across services
Event-driven reliability: Kafka consumers use retries and dedicated dead-letter queues
Database per service: PostgreSQL with Prisma plus Elasticsearch for search
Production safeguards: JWT authorization, rate limiting, circuit breakers, Redis locks and idempotency
Containerized infrastructure: Docker Compose runs PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch and observability tools
